parts.stem: Order the steps showing what would happen to a prey population in the absence of their predators.

items.value: The death of a big number of prey organisms occurs.
Competition and diseases increase among prey organisms.
The number of prey organisms increases.
The amount of resources available for prey decreases.

correct_answer: The number of prey organisms increases.
The amount of resources available for prey decreases.
Competition and diseases increase among prey organisms.
The death of a big number of prey organisms occurs.
